author: The Infographics Show
description:
Sora was supposed to be the future of entertainment. Now, it’s six feet under. In late 2025, OpenAI released Sora 2 with the promise of turning every user into a Hollywood director. It hit a million users faster than almost any app in history. But by January 2026, the dream was over. In today's new episode, we reveal the internal "Red Alert" at OpenAI that led to Sora being stripped of its resources and left to die.

We dive into the $15 million-a-day GPU burn, the legal war with the Motion Picture Association, and the creepy "Characters" feature that terrified users into hitting the delete button. From "AI slop" feeds to the massive biometric privacy scandals, find out why you can’t automate a soul, and why the world’s most advanced video AI crashed and burned in record time.
